title: Ambatukam Music Disc
description: Replaces Music Disc 11 with the "Ambatukam Termuwani" song.
body:
This resourcepacks replaces music disc 11 with the song Ambatukam Termuwani by DJ Nansuya.
The texture is a reshaded version of the music disc "Otherside", which is reshaded in purple.
The description of the item sadly was not changed as I couldn't figure out how to change it because the en/us json file wouldn't change it.
